fields.title: KNB Scholarship – Indonesian Government
fields.description: The Kemitraan Negara Berkembang (KNB) Scholarship is a prestigious Indonesian Government scholarship for students from developing countries to pursue Master degree programs at top Indonesian universities.
fields.benefits:
Full tuition fee coverage
Monthly living allowance (IDR 2,500,000)
Accommodation support
Return airfare
Health insurance
Indonesian language course
fields.requirements:
Bachelor degree with minimum GPA 3.0
Age maximum 35 years
TOEFL score minimum 500 or IELTS 5.5
Not currently receiving other scholarship
Letter of motivation
Recommendation letters x2

fields.title: Universitas Brawijaya Scholarship
fields.description: Full scholarship for international students from West Africa and other developing nations to pursue undergraduate studies at one of Indonesia's leading universities located in Malang, East Java.
fields.benefits:
Full tuition waiver
Monthly stipend IDR 1,500,000
Dormitory accommodation
Academic mentorship
Cultural exchange program
fields.requirements:
High school diploma with excellent grades
Age 17-25 years
Basic English proficiency
Motivation letter
Passport copy
Health certificate

fields.title: UMM International Student Grant
fields.description: Partial to full scholarship program for international students, especially from Muslim-majority countries in Africa, to study at UMM in Malang, Indonesia — a university with a strong African student community.
fields.benefits:
50-100% tuition discount
Housing assistance
Academic support
Islamic activities & community
fields.requirements:
Bachelor degree
Minimum GPA 3.0
Health certificate
Motivation letter in English
Proof of financial need

fields.title: Universitas Negeri Malang – DIKE Program
fields.description: The Diversity and International Knowledge Exchange program offers places for talented students from West Africa to study education, science, and technology at UM in Malang.
fields.benefits:
Tuition fee support
Mentorship from local students
Cultural immersion program
Certificate of achievement
fields.requirements:
Secondary school certificate
Good academic record
English or Indonesian basic proficiency
Interview
